paragraphs.body: Chelsea FC Latest News .com reports that the club has promoted Penders and Sharman-Lowe following an injury to Emi Martinez. FootballTransfers.com notes that Manu Kone is being viewed as a record signing. Talk Chelsea states that a £100m target could yet sign a new contract, a claim made by his boss. London Evening Standard provides an injury update regarding Martinez, Chavarria, and James. Flashscore.com indicates Chelsea are searching for new right-back options amid Gusto's uncertainty.

headline: Chelsea moves on injuries, transfer targets, and squad searches
